tools.name: Read incident evidence by immutable ID
acceptance_checks: Reject foreign-tenant or foreign-incident IDs.
Preserve content hash and source timestamps; never fabricate missing content.
expected_evidence: Immutable evidence ID, content hash, source, source_timestamp and collected_at.

tools.name: Read bounded incident evidence timeline
acceptance_checks: Return bounded deterministic timestamp ordering and pagination.
Disclose truncation and collection gaps; do not infer events from summaries.
expected_evidence: Evidence IDs, source times, collection times and pagination/truncation metadata.

tools.name: Validate incident evidence citations
acceptance_checks: Reject missing, foreign-tenant and foreign-incident citations.
Citation existence does not prove the associated claim; disclose stale or inadequate support.
expected_evidence: Citation validity, cited IDs, content hashes and unsupported-claim explanations.

tools.name: Assess scoped response eligibility
acceptance_checks: Fail closed when exact endpoint identity, allowlist, permission or protected-path evidence is unavailable.
Assessment grants no approval and consumes no dispatch quota.
expected_evidence: Canonical endpoint/target identity, policy version, allowlist snapshot and risk/exclusion reasons.

tools.name: Draft immutable scoped response proposal
acceptance_checks: Bind exact provider, endpoint, target, parameters, evidence IDs, approval expiry, effect expiry and owned undo behavior.
Return a plan and proposal hash without dispatching or approving it.
expected_evidence: Canonical proposal hash, prerequisites, blast radius, evidence IDs, expected effect and verification/undo plan.

tools.name: Review proposal evidence and prerequisites
acceptance_checks: Identify unsupported attribution, unavailable capabilities and contradictory evidence.
Reject a plan whose outcome predicates or legitimate-health checks are missing.
expected_evidence: Proposal hash, unmet prerequisites, evidence disagreements and expected-outcome predicates.

tools.name: Evaluate independent outcome evidence
acceptance_checks: Provider acknowledgement alone cannot satisfy verification.
Require fresh exact-target observation plus intended effect and legitimate-health checks; otherwise report pending, failed or unknown.
expected_evidence: Observation evidence IDs, expected predicates, freshness, independent source/run identity and uncertainty.

tools.name: Read attempt-owned endpoint block rule
acceptance_checks: Read the exact endpoint and attempt-owned rule without changing it.
Manager acknowledgement is not endpoint execution evidence.
expected_evidence: Endpoint observation timestamp, target IP, rule handle/ownership and provider request ID.

tools.name: Read controlled lab attacker-path observation
acceptance_checks: Require an authorized lab path and bounded predeclared connectivity observation; no attack generation.
Correlate baseline and post-action observations to the exact endpoint, source and protocol.
expected_evidence: Independent lab observation ID, vantage, source/destination, protocol, timestamps and connectivity outcome.

tools.name: Read legitimate lab management and service health
acceptance_checks: Check declared legitimate management and service paths independently of the containment acknowledgement.
Missing or degraded health prevents a successful response verification claim.
expected_evidence: Independent management/service observations, baseline comparison, timestamps and degraded-path details.

tools.name: Read response state for unknown-outcome reconciliation
acceptance_checks: Read provider and endpoint state using request ID and owned rule identity before any retry or undo.
Contradiction or absent authoritative observation remains unknown; this tool never replays an action.
expected_evidence: Proposal/attempt identity, provider state, endpoint state, observation IDs and unresolved discrepancies.

tools.name: Draft evidence-grounded incident report
acceptance_checks: Cite immutable evidence and distinguish request, approval, acknowledgement, execution and verification.
Do not close incidents, export externally or claim unavailable telemetry was collected.
expected_evidence: Incident timeline, evidence citations, model/tool provenance, gaps and response-state summary.

tools.name: Review recorded outcomes for improvement opportunities
acceptance_checks: Use recorded outcomes and measured failures; no rule publication or automatic policy change.
Label proposals as untested and distinguish simulations from real rehearsals.
expected_evidence: Incident/evidence IDs, measured failure or noise, proposed improvement and validation requirements.

tools.name: Request temporary attacker-IP block through Wazuh
acceptance_checks: Trusted response service only; no specialist or model may call this contract directly.
Atomically require a current exact-proposal human approval, target protection, durable quota, cancellation/lease fence and idempotent dispatch intent.
Record acknowledgement separately from endpoint execution and independent verification; timeout becomes unknown without blind replay.
expected_evidence: Proposal hash, approval ID, attempt ID, dispatch intent, provider request ID, owned endpoint rule handle and expiry.

tools.name: Remove only the attempt-owned temporary block
acceptance_checks: Trusted response service only; manual undo and expiry use the original approved cleanup scope.
Reconcile unknown state first; never remove a preexisting or foreign-owned rule.
Persist expiry/undo intent across restart and independently verify rule absence and legitimate connectivity.
expected_evidence: Original proposal/approval/attempt IDs, exact owned rule, cleanup trigger, provider acknowledgement and recovery observation IDs.

tools.name: Draft detection change with regression criteria
acceptance_checks: Planned future capability; reject version 1.0 admission, assignment and dispatch.
Read or draft only within the granted incident scope; disclose unavailable telemetry and truncation.
expected_evidence: Pinned rule version, evidence fixtures, expected true/false positives and untested draft diff.

Permit only the named typed operation; no arbitrary shell, script, URL, API method or bulk wildcard target.
